a.lede: Several Apple services went down for maintenance on the afternoon of September 30. Only Apple TV remains inaccessible.
a.title: Apple TV is down

b.lede: Apple says the bug was used to attack "specific targeted individuals" running iOS 26, which the majority of Apple customers are still using.
b.title: Still running iOS 26? Update your iPhones, iPads and Macs for this urgent security fix
